name: Beskonechnoe Leto 2.0
source:
A fan-made sequel to [url=/v3126]Beskonechnoe leto[/url], which includes Olga's, Electronik's, and Pioneer's routes.

[Translated from [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=489166362]Steam[/url]]

[spoiler]All of the above is a lie. This is a retelling of the original with random phrases inserted in between the original script.[/spoiler]
translation:
粉丝自制的[url=/v3126]《永恒之夏》[/url]续作，收录了奥尔加线、电子线与少先队员线。

[译自[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=489166362]Steam[/url]]

[spoiler]以上介绍全是骗人的。本作其实只是在原作剧本的字里行间随机塞进各种无厘头台词重讲一遍而已。[/spoiler]
